name: Ginny
source:
A workaholic, machine-loving farmgirl from Home Planet's surface. Also a little clumsy. She's cheerful, but a little naive. Or maybe that's just the face she wears...

[from [url=http://starwish.auriplane.net/?Characters]official site[/url]]
